cues.text: Hmm, you just arrived at a comfy hotel.
You look at the lobby, and it has warm, cozy lightning.
The lobby is the area where you find the reception, front desk, seats, and waiting areas.
You walk to the front desk to check in.
It’s a very calm night at the hotel, so the lobby is quiet and peaceful.
You hear the receptionist slowly typing your information into the computer,
and you receive your room key.
Listen, you get into the elevator and press the button for the right floor.
When you arrive, the elevator stops.
The hotel hallway smells so nice,
and it feels so peaceful that you walk through it slowly.
A hallway is a long passage inside a building, with doors or rooms along it.
It can also be called a corridor.
You open the door to your room and see a big, comfy bed.
The bed looks so soft and inviting.
It has clean white sheets, fluffy pillows, and a warm blanket.
Sheets cover the bed.
You lie on them when you sleep.
They’re usually soft and can be white or other colors.
You appreciate the room for a while,
and then you go to the bathroom and turn on the faucet to fill the Jacuzzi for a bath.
We usually take a bath in a bathtub or Jacuzzi and take a shower when there is a shower.
When you get into the Jacuzzi, you feel the warm water relaxing all your muscles.
You rest your head on the edge of Jacuzzi and relax as much as possible.
Enjoy this cozy moment at the hotel.
See you soon!
